history.critique: The draft captures the synthwave aesthetic well with the grid and sun, but fails critical functional requirements. 1) Brief Alignment: The 'START' button is completely missing, rendering the menu non-functional. The 'four-lane note highway' is present but appears as a thin, flat 2D strip superimposed over the sun, lacking the width and perspective of a playable rhythm game lane. 2) Clarity & Hierarchy: With the title anchored at the bottom and no call-to-action, the user has no clear path forward.
